汤姆的生活方式(Tom's Way of Living): 一篇关于节日文化的B1记叙文:汤姆的经历、感受与成长。

Tom ordered noodles and milk at the holiday plan last night. People around Tom often share different ideas about the spring market. At first, Tom found it difficult to keep the habit. The school arranged an excursion to the museum.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Tom thanked Leo for the honest advice. Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. They sat on a bench in the park.

The holiday plan has become an important part of daily life. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The spring market looked quieter than usual that evening. For example, birds fly south in winter.

There are always more possibilities than we expect. Tom has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. Leo advised Tom to try drawing as a new hobby. What's more, my stepsister joins us each summer.
Leo always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Tom believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. The experience taught Tom more than any book could.
